title.zh: Cardano’s Splash fix patches the exploit, but leaves 2.4M ADA missing and holders trapped
title.en: Cardano’s Splash fix patches the exploit, but leaves 2.4M ADA missing and holders trapped

current_state.zh: Splash patched the validator flaw behind a Sept. 13 exploit that drained 2,434,648 ADA and 1,988,222 OADA from its Cardano ADA/OADA StableSwap pool, but the missing ADA leaves OADA holders without meaningful exit liquidity.
current_state.en: Splash patched the validator flaw behind a Sept. 13 exploit that drained 2,434,648 ADA and 1,988,222 OADA from its Cardano ADA/OADA StableSwap pool, but the missing ADA leaves OADA holders without meaningful exit liquidity.
